verdict.rationale: A probe confirmed a live llms.txt at docs.pipecat.ai (HTTP 200), and the docs are served as raw .md pages that an agent can ingest directly. Pipecat also ships agent-oriented tooling: `pipecat context-hub install` registers a local docs/examples/API index as an MCP server for coding agents, a runtime probe confirmed that command exists, and the quickstart scaffold writes AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md. Missing for 10: independent community reports of agents actually using llms.txt or context-hub, and evidence of a full-content llms-full.txt variant.
